These Terms and Conditions (hereafter the “Terms”) govern the use of the website ar-elia.com and the provision of the commercial services offered by Arelia — Industrial Laundry (hereafter “Arelia”).

02 Subject matter and services

Arelia provides professional industrial laundry services aimed at the B2B segment, focused on hospitality, restaurants and related sectors. Available services include, without limitation:

  • Washing, disinfection and finishing of hotel linen (sheets, pillowcases, towels, towelling)
  • Treatment of professional uniforms and restaurant linen
  • Collection and delivery across the Algarve and in areas to be agreed contractually
  • Textile rental (subject to a specific contract)
  • Operational consultancy and ROI analysis

The technical detail of each service, pricing, lead times and SLAs are set out in the individual commercial quote issued to each client after their needs have been assessed.

Arelia reserves the right to accept or decline any request, in particular on grounds of operational capacity, geographic area or the suitability of the service requested.

04 ROI calculator

The “ROI calculator” provided on the website gives purely indicative estimates, based on sector averages and on the data the user chooses to enter.

The figures it produces do not constitute a commercial offer and cannot be relied on as binding. The final quote may vary according to factors specific to the client’s actual operation, location, real volume and the contractual terms negotiated.
